mistakes: The 2026-09-25 page (decision paper-2026-09-25-allcash-21d-468d) ended 'The next decision is for 2026-09-28'; the routine records one decision a night including weekends (paper-2026-09-19-allcash-21d-b7bd, paper-2026-09-20-allcash-21d-dbaf), and tonight's row paper-2026-09-26-allcash-21d-cf74 is dated 2026-09-26.
lessons: A weekend row carries no new price, only new measurement; a decision that changes on a weekend should name the re-measurement that changed it.
A page's statement about the routine is a claim about a ledger and the ledger can check it: 'the next decision is for 2026-09-28' was false against weekend rows already recorded.
